page_title: MON 1-2 AUG | B. Monchengladbach v Augsburg 21/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Augsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+4' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90+3' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
90+2' The attendance is 44867.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Wasted opportunity. Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
87' The game has come to an end for Franck Honorat. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach).
86' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Finn Dahmen, who smothers the ball.
85' One of the players from B. Monchengladbach times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
83' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arne Maier (Augsburg) replacing Ruben Vargas.
83' A substitution has been made. Phillip Tietz goes off and Dion Beljo (Augsburg) comes on.
83' The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
83' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
80' Martin Petersen shows a yellow card to Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
78' Alassane Plea links up with Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach), who fires just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.

77' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
77' Now B. Monchengladbach have a corner.
76' A cross from a corner kick by Augsburg is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

76' Iago (Augsburg) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.

75' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Finn Dahmen shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) replaces Arne Engels.
72' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
71' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luca Netz.
71' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Manu Kone will be replaced by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach).
71' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) offside.
69' The ball is cleared after Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
67' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
67' A substitution has been made. Robin Hack is replaced by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
65' Manu Kone has a look up and finds Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
64' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
64' The ball is out of play and Augsburg manage to earn a corner.
63' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
60' Jess Thorup has decided to substitute Fredrik Jensen and he is replaced by Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg).
60' The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
59' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

59' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Finn Dahmen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
58' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
57' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
57' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.

55' The fans were almost celebrating as Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas made an astonishing save!
54' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.

51' 1 - 2 Arne Engels (Augsburg) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:2.
49' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.

47' 1 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Kevin Mbabu finds Phillip Tietz (Augsburg), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header to the middle in the countermovement of the keeper. His effort was both strong and precise, and Moritz Nicolas had no chance of stopping that. 1:1.
46' Gerardo Seoane makes a half-time substitution. Christoph Kramer comes on in place of Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach).
46' Referee Martin Petersen blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+11' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+11' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
45+9' B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
45+9' Arne Engels (Augsburg) commits a rough challenge and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
45+7' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) and Felix Uduokhai are exchanging a few passes as if neither of them want to be the one to start a new attack.
45+5' A player from Augsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
45+4' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
45+3' A player from B. Monchengladbach brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
45+3' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) smashes the ball upfield and Franck Honorat controls it with a great first touch.

45+1' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a lofted pass from the free kick and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by the excellent Finn Dahmen.
45' 10 additional min. will be played.
44' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
41' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
40' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner kick.
40' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
36' It wasn't the best example of how to strike the ball. Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) unleashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box that went high over the crossbar.
35' Augsburg get a corner.
34' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) made himself some space to unleash an effort goalwards from about 32 metres out, but the ball went well wide of the left post.
33' Good movement by Iago (Augsburg), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
32' Martin Petersen interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
28' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Moritz Nicolas makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!

26' 1 - 0 Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) scores! He won himself some space inside the box after a cross from the corner kick and blasts the ball into the net. His effort went inside the left post.
26' B. Monchengladbach force their opponents to concede a corner.
25' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
24' Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
14' A dangerous looking corner kick from Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) is cleared to safety by the defence.

13' What a great chance for Ruben Vargas (Augsburg). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
12' Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
11' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
9' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
8' Arne Engels (Augsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
7' Martin Petersen blows his whistle. Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play.
6' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
5' Iago (Augsburg) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
4' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Iago (Augsburg) but poses no threat.
2' Arne Engels (Augsburg) commits a rough foul. Martin Petersen stops the game and makes a call.
